# Pluswrld

> Pluswrld is the digital consultancy of Paul Oloruntobi. It builds and improves Shopify and ecommerce stores, business websites, no-code applications, AI and business automations, creator-commerce and membership systems, and paid advertising campaigns.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/): Overview of Pluswrld's work and capabilities.
- [About](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/about): Background, working approach and capabilities of Paul Oloruntobi.
- [How I Can Help](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/how-i-can-help): Common business needs supported by Pluswrld.
- [Services](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/services): Service overview and delivery scope.
- [Process](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/process): Project discovery, planning, implementation, testing and handover.
- [Selected Work](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/work): Portfolio of selected digital projects.
- [Testimonials](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/testimonials): Published client feedback.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/faq): Common questions about working with Pluswrld.
- [Contact](https://pluswrld-portfolio.vercel.app/contact): Project enquiry and contact options.
